papers.title: Finding the Right Balance: Relevance and Diversity in LLM Retrieval
papers.recency: Newly reviewed recent paper; not claimed published after last survey
papers.official_code_commit: not pinned; independently implemented equations, no upstream source copied
papers.problem: Repeated similar evidence can occupy top-k; indiscriminate diversity can displace correct evidence
papers.method: RNG score with strict closer-neighbor obstruction and selective Vendi/MMR; h1 exact nearest fallback
papers.conditions: Strong/weak encoders, fixed pools; multi-evidence QA, controlled duplicates/overlap; h deployment estimator remains unresolved
papers.cost: Existing normalized embeddings, small CPU matrix operations; no teacher/generator/model download
papers.risk: False h2 assumption and clean-pool diversification lower relevance; alternate acceptable gold documents do not establish complementary evidence
papers.developer_sets: RAG A180 and previously used B160; not itinerary A-E or fresh holdout
papers.holdout: New independent travel retrieval evidence labels required; previously used H not read
papers.criteria: Each set Recall@3>=90%, null false display<=2%, shown gold>=dense baseline, no new null false positives
papers.state: Implemented, logic7/7; frozen five-variant measurement complete; gates failed; not adopted

papers.title: Page-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for EvalLLM 2026
papers.recency: Recent background found after expanding window
papers.official_code_commit: Not identified in inspected manuscript; implementation availability not exhaustively established
papers.problem: Semantic and lexical retrieval disagree; multi-part request may need separate evidence
papers.method: Page-aware PDF chunks, dense/BM25 RRF, cross-encoder, optional query decomposition
papers.conditions: French PDF595 challenge; 220-word chunks/40 overlap; RRF constant60/pools60; rerank25; gpt-5.4-mini generation
papers.cost: RRF CPU low; cross-encoder/decomposition add inference and latency
papers.risk: Dense or fused retrieval can underperform BM25; decomposition prompts/count/aggregation incompletely specified
papers.developer_sets: Same frozen RAG A180/B160 for isolated RRF component only
papers.holdout: New independent retrieval labels; no final holdout accessed
papers.criteria: Same per-set retrieval/null gate as preregistration; no full-PDF or generator reproduction claim
papers.state: RRF component implemented/tested; A null false4->2, B recall35->33; failed, no product change

papers.title: SFT Doesn't Always Hurt General Capabilities
papers.recency: Older background/reproduction candidate; not new October result
papers.official_code_commit: Not pinned in this review; implementation deferred
papers.problem: Our trained models trade lower false picks for lower normal-request accuracy
papers.method: Low learning rate and detached token-loss-dependent TALR weights with floor; weighted mean over supervised tokens, not weight renormalization
papers.conditions: Domain supervised tasks and general capability checks; validate tau/floor/masking and packed batches before recipe
papers.cost: Same teacher-free forward/backward, added per-token loss and class diagnostics
papers.risk: Rare item IDs and null tokens may receive lower weight; short JSON target differs from paper tasks
papers.developer_sets: Fixed normal/null/compound and D/H/E regression diagnostics; current FINCH/cosine repeat must finish first
papers.holdout: Independent travel normal240/null480, human adjudication and frozen hashes pending
papers.criteria: No normal-request regression, null upper limit and independent holdout; multiple paired seeds, no best-seed selection
papers.state: Method reviewed; not implemented, queued or adopted; resume with class/token-loss probe after existing controlled schedules
